# Add spreadsheet
  /spreadsheets --add
    --document_id="13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4"
    --expense_range="Лист1!G29:J110"
    --rest_balance_cell="Лист1!M7"

# Curl variant
  curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/telegram/webhook \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
      "message": {
        "message_id": 1,
        "text": "/spreadsheets --add --document_id=\"13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4\" --expense_range=\"Лист1!G29:J110\" --rest_balance_cell=\"Лист1!M7\"",
        "from": { "id": 111, "username": "test_user", "is_bot": false },
        "chat": { "id": 111, "type": "private" },
        "date": 1700000000
      }
    }'
